tools.name: Physical input
tools.description: Bring in a selected microphone or other Windows capture endpoint.

tools.name: Application capture
tools.description: Capture audio from a selected running application process tree.

tools.name: Endpoint loopback
tools.description: Capture the sound being rendered by a selected output endpoint.

tools.name: Test signal
tools.description: Generate a controlled tone to check a route and its levels.

tools.name: Audio file
tools.description: Play imported WAV or MP3 audio into a session, with optional looping.

tools.name: Network receive
tools.description: Receive an AudioRouter audio stream from another computer on your network.

tools.name: Physical output
tools.description: Render a route to a selected Windows audio output.

tools.name: Recorder
tools.description: Record one route branch to WAV, FLAC, or MP3.

tools.name: Network send
tools.description: Send audio from a branch to another AudioRouter computer over UDP.

tools.name: Mixer
tools.description: Combine explicit upstream sources and set each input's level.

tools.name: Input switch
tools.description: Choose between input A and B with a crossfade.

tools.name: Gain
tools.description: Set a precise gain in decibels.

tools.name: Volume
tools.description: Set a simple level from 0 to 200 percent.

tools.name: Mute
tools.description: Silence or restore a branch while retaining its route.

tools.name: Meter
tools.description: Inspect peak, RMS, clipping, and reduction telemetry.

tools.name: Parametric EQ
tools.description: Shape up to sixteen enabled bands with shelf, pass, and notch filters.

tools.name: Graphic EQ
tools.description: Adjust ten familiar graphic equalizer bands.

tools.name: Bass & Treble
tools.description: Adjust low and high shelves with straightforward controls.

tools.name: FIR Filter
tools.description: Apply a supplied impulse response using convolution.

tools.name: Compressor
tools.description: Control peaks and even out the level with threshold, ratio, timing, and makeup.

tools.name: Gate / Expander
tools.description: Turn down audio below a threshold while preserving deliberate signal flow.

tools.name: Limiter
tools.description: Set a sample-peak ceiling with lookahead.

tools.name: Duck
tools.description: Lower a target source in response to another node's level or supported game phase.

tools.name: Delay
tools.description: Add a controlled delay from 0 to 1,000 ms.

tools.name: Time Shift
tools.description: Pause, jump back or forward, and return to live audio with a bounded buffer.

tools.name: Pitch
tools.description: Shift pitch by semitones and cents in a streaming processor.

tools.name: Dehum
tools.description: Reduce mains hum and harmonics at 50 or 60 Hz.

tools.name: Declick
tools.description: Repair click and crackle transients.

tools.name: Denoise
tools.description: Learn a noise profile and reduce steady background noise.

tools.name: Speech Denoise
tools.description: Reduce noise with spectral processing tuned for speech.

tools.name: Spectral Gate
tools.description: Learn a per-frequency noise floor and turn down bands beneath it.

tools.name: VST Plugin
tools.description: Host a compatible installed x64 VST3 effect or a qualified x64 VST2 effect in an isolated worker.
